0022600215.text: The Kings (1-8, 0-4 at home) are on a two-game losing streak and sit 14th in the West, while the Magic (2-7) have lost four straight and are 12th in the East. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness; 15.3 points and 35.5 minutes per game this season), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), with Desmond Bane listed as day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Kings lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
